day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSanta Teresa waseJesu, iNtokazi noGqirha weBandla
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube nani ugrace noxolo oluvela kuThixo uBawo wethu naseNkosini yethu uYesu Kristu.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehlala phantsi ekhaya, echitha ixesha lakhe ebhala iikhowudi zeenkqubo zakhe zekhompyutha. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo, esakha ikamva lakhe ngengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwento ebonwa ngamehlo. Wayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuzibona iindiza zayo zibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usikhumbuza inyaniso enzulu: 'In love he destined us for adoption to himself through Jesus Christ, in accord with the favor of his will.' (Ngothando wasimiselayo ukuba samkelwe njengabantwana bakhe ngoYesu Kristu, ngokokuthanda kwakhe). Le nyaniso isikhumbuza ukuba uBen, nangona iminyaka yakhe yayimfutshane, wayengowakhe uThixo ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba ubekho. Wayengumntwana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. Wayengumfana owayephulaphula, owayenika, owayezama ukwenza uthando lube yinto ebonakalayo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaLuka, uYesu ukhankanya amazwi abuhlungu kwaye anzulu kubafundi bomthetho nabaFarisi. Uthi: 'You have taken away the key of knowledge. You yourselves did not enter and you stopped those trying to enter.' Lo mfanekiso wesitshixo esilahlekileyo usikhumbuza ubunzima bokuba ngumntu phantsi kweli hlabathi. Ubomi buhlala busibeka imithwalo enzima kakhulu, ngakumbi xa umntu othandekayo ehamba. Kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele ekhaya kuThixo, kukho imizuzu apho umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uziva unzima kakhulu. Ucinga ngaloo mboniso kaBen esesemncinci, xa wayecinga ngokunika yonke imali yasebhange encinci yakhe ukuba incede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayisengcamango yentliziyo yakhe emsulwa, kodwa loo nqaku lokuba umntwana omncane kangaka abe nomnqweno wokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala kuyasityhilela ukuba intliziyo kaBen yayingenabuzoweni, yayizaliswe luthando olunyulu lukaThixo.

Masimi apha ixesha elincinci… Masicinge ngendlela ubomi bukaBen obabuzaliswe ngayo kukukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhleka, owayejonga uyise ngamehlo okumncoma, owayeyazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukuba ngumntu owabelana ngovuyo nabanye. Kwakunye nomnqweno wakhe wokwakha i-‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, eyayiziindiza zamaphupha akhe, uBen wayesixelela ukuba umphefumlo womntwana awuyeki ukubhabha. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha nawe Alan, nawe Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ngendlela enyanisekileyo. Ndiyazi ukuba umthwalo wosizi uyamfulathela umntu ebusuku. Kukho imibuzo eza ithi, 'Kutheni?' Kukho amaxesha apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphelela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi kwabo babesenza imithetho kodwa bengekho eluthandweni, 'Nibe nobulungisa nothando lukaThixo.' Ubulungisa bukaThixo asisisiqwenga somthetho esixinzelelayo; lububele obukukhululayo. UBen akalahlekanga; usebukhoneni obukhulu boMthombo wothando. Uthi xa ucinga ngaye, ucinga ngaloo ntwana enemfesane, umfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu kangaka. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kule Ntsikelelo yeSakramente. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngeSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nakanye. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isikhokelele eluxolweni lwayo ngonaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemfazweni yosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: UPawulos, umpostile kaKristu Yesu ngokuthanda kukaThixo, kubangcwele abase-Efese nakwabathembekileyo kuKristu Yesu: grace nibe nalo noxolo oluvela kuThixo uBawo wethu naseNkosini uYesu Kristu. Makabongwe uThixo uBawo weNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, osisikelele kuKristu ngazo zonke iintsikelelo zomoya ezisemazulwini, njengoko asinyulayo kuye, phambi kokusekwa kwehlabathi, ukuze sibe ngcwele kwaye singenasiphako phambi kwakhe. Ngothando wasimiselayo ukuba samkelwe njengabantwana bakhe ngoYesu Kristu, ngokokuthanda kwaye nangenxa yenceba yakhe, ukuze kudunyiswe uzuko lenceba yakhe ayinikele kuthi ngaye oyiNyana wakhe othandekayo. KuKristu sinokuhlawulelwa ngeGazi lakhe, ukuxolelwa kwezono, ngokobutyebi benceba yakhe ayithululele kuthi ngobuninzi. Ngako konke ubulumko nokuqonda, usazisile imfihlelo yokuthanda kwakhe ngokokuthanda kwakhe, akumisayo kuye njengesicwangciso sokuzelelwa kwamaxesha, ukuze adibanise zonke izinto kuKristu, ezisemazulwini nezasemhlabeni.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo. Mvumelani iNkosi ingoma entsha, kuba yenze imisebenzi emangalisayo; isandla sayo sokunene siye sayinika uloyiso, ingalo yayo engcwele. R. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo: emehlweni eentlanga iye yatyhila ubulungisa bayo. Iye yakhumbula ububele bayo nokuthembeka kwayo kwindlu yakwaSirayeli. R. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo. Zonke iziphelo zomhlaba zibonile usindiso lukaThixo wethu. Mvumelani iNkosi ngovuyo, nina zizwe zonke; qhumani ngengoma; vumani iindumiso. R. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo. Vumani iindumiso eNkosini ngenqanaba, ngenqanaba nangengoma emnandi. Nangezitolopho nangomsindo wexilongo vumani ngovuyo phambi koKumkani, iNkosi. R. INkosi iye yazisa usindiso lwayo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: INkosi yathi: “Wethu nina bakha izikhumbuzo zabaprofeti ababulawa ngooyihlo. Ngoko ke, ningqina kwaye nivumelana nemisebenzi yooyihlo, kuba bona bababulala, nina ke niyakha. Ngenxa yoko, ubulumko bukaThixo buthe, ‘Ndiya kubathumelela abaprofeti nabapostile; abanye babo baya kubabulala kwaye babatshutshise,’ ukuze esi sizukulwana sityholwe ngegazi labaprofeti bonke elaphalalayo ukususela ekusekweni kwehlabathi, ukususela egazini lika-Abheli kuye egazini likaZakariya owafela phakathi kwesibingelelo netempile. Ewe, ndithi kuni, esi sizukulwana siya kutyholwa ngegazi labo! Wethu nina, zazi zomtsetho! Nithathile isitshixo solwazi. Nina aningeni, kwaye nabathintela abo bazama ukungena.” Xa uYesu emka, ababhali nabaFarisi baqala ukumphatha ngobundlobongela, kwaye bamcinezela ngemibuzo emininzi, kuba babecwangcisa ukumbamba ngento anokuyithetha.

day: Memorial of Saint Teresa of Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
